n20.title: Residual of a fit
n20.statement: Fit a line through `([0, 1, 2], [1, 3, 5])`, predict at the inputs, and store the total absolute residual as a float in `result`.
n20.solution:
import numpy as np
x = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 2.0])
y = np.array([1.0, 3.0, 5.0])

result = float(np.abs(np.polyval(coeffs, x) - y).sum())
print(result)
